entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Support' or 'Sales' to be routed to the correct department.
Connecting you to a VeloFit support agent now.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Diana. Can I get your name and order number to start?
Mark Peterson, order number VF88912. And I want to return this piece of junk you sent me.

Okay, Mr. Peterson, I've pulled up your order for the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor. I can certainly look into the return options for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
What do you mean 'preference'? It's broken! It's not working at all. I've charged it for hours and it won't sync with my phone. This thing is completely defective and I want my money back now!

I'm very sorry to hear you're having that trouble. Since the issue is that it won't sync and seems to be a technical fault, our standard procedure is to transfer you to our Tech Support team. They have advanced tools to diagnose if the unit is defective and...

NO! Absolutely not! I am NOT wasting my time with another department. I bought a product, it's broken, and I want a refund. It's that simple! Get me your manager right now. This is the worst service I've ever had. I'll be leaving reviews everywhere.
Okay, sir, I understand your frustration. There's no need for a manager, let me just check the return eligibility for you right now. One moment while I pull up the policy details for your purchase.
Alright, thank you for holding. I've confirmed your order details. I see you received the item 14 days ago, and our company return policy allows for returns up to 90 days from the date of delivery.
So you can do it then?

Yes, absolutely. You are well within the 90-day window. I'm processing the return for you now. I've just sent a prepaid shipping label to the email address on file. Just package the defective band and drop it off, and you'll receive a full refund once it's processed at our warehouse.
Fine. That's what you should have done from the start. Just make sure that email comes through.
It has been sent, Mr. Peterson. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
